scope: Articulated forward weapon draws, recoil, rotating minigun with spin-up/down, pump shotgun shell-load/rack, double-barrel break/eject/load/close, and reverse lowering actions. Includes camera-forward bat, turret and Helios attacks, Armadroid transformation and roll, and 72 directional poses. Full soldier movement and cover sets remain a separate conversion.
